(i) the self-induced curriculum learning in SS-NMT is a combination of (ii) increasing task-relevance, (iii) increasing complexity, (iv) denoising, and (v) mutual supervision of system internal representations.

the SS-NMT system learns to select samples that are (i) of increasing task-relevance and (ii) increasing GF, in a way such that (iii) the model learns to translate more complex sentences first.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the model learns a curriculum for itself.

, without any explicit guidance, the neural machine translation model learns how to sample training examples in a way that it learns to extract and translate more complex data, which is crucial for the model to achieve high translation quality.
